definitions.scores: Input fractions; endpoint output percentages; all SDs and paired differences in percentage points.
definitions.aggregation: Each defined case has equal weight; population SD uses divisor n; nulls are excluded and listed.
definitions.worst_ceil20: Mean of the lowest ceil(0.2*n_defined) scores; selected independently per metric or paired-delta vector.
definitions.paired_delta: Per-case linear contrast first, then case-equal summary; all terms must be defined for that case.
definitions.native_GT_support: Reported GT voxel count, volume, skeleton count, fine support and radius agree; this is not voxelwise label-hash verification.
definitions.centerline: Lee skeleton voxel overlap on each native grid; not physical branch length.
definitions.fine_centerline_recall: Recall on GT native Lee skeleton sites with native physical EDT radius <=2 mm; zero support yields null.
definitions.F_to_final: Subsequent training pipeline difference from selected F, not a budget-matched isolated component ablation.
definitions.dispersion_scope: Across-case dispersion within the fixed seed; seed stability is not measured.
definitions.missing: No metric rows or deltas are generated for an absent endpoint.

input_hash_scope: F and AR_GDF use their saved JSON byte hashes. Three embedded tail metrics use canonical sorted-key compact JSON hashes; enclosing completion-observation byte hash is in provenance.json.
